verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an API to suppress and delete user data according to suppression policies. Its compliance page says deletion requests are pushed to the entire stack from one central platform, which covers both processing requests and forwarding them downstream. Both claims are single-line, first-party statements only. missing for 10: detailed docs on which destinations support deletion forwarding, request status tracking and completion confirmation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations

citations.quote: Suppress and delete user data in accordance with your user suppression policies
When users update preferences or request to be deleted, push the change to your entire stack from one centralized platform.
